HenrySkillz MPC Sample Installer

Adds the HenrySkillz FX rack, EQ display and splash to SampQOL OS 0.2.0 on an MPC Sample (firmware 1.3.0). Everything happens in this page. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

  1. Download SampQOL-OS-v0.2.0.zip from the official page: github.com/snarebes/SampQOL-OS/releases
  2. Drop that zip here (or, if your Mac already unzipped it, choose the SampQOL-OS-v0.2.0 folder).
  3. Save the autorun-hs.zip this page gives you, unzip it, and copy the autorun folder to the top of your SD card.

Drop the SampQOL zip here

Waiting for SampQOL…

Already installed? Update just the effects

Your card already has an autorun/hs folder from this page. You only need the new effect files, and you do not need SampQOL again.

  1. Switch the MPC off, put the SD card in your computer and copy autorun/hs somewhere safe as a backup.
  3. Unzip it and copy the four .so files into autorun/hs on the card, replacing the old ones. Replace all four together.
  4. Eject the card, switch the MPC on and press B1.

These files are not part of the signed autorun, so nothing needs re-signing. If the MPC boots stock or restarts twice, put your backup of autorun/hs back.

Back up your SD card first. To undo: switch off and take the SD card out, or delete the autorun folder from it. Step-by-step help with pictures: install guide · FAQ · report a problem

SampQOL OS is by Snare Bes, not HenrySkillz. This page never contains or uploads it: you download it from his official page, and his license, name and start screen stay in your copy. Please take questions about the HS effects to our issues page, not to him.
